sentences.text: The generic name Decuriasuchus means "unit of ten crocodiles," referencing the ten known specimens.
All known specimens of Decuriasuchus represent immature individuals.
The known specimens of Decuriasuchus are around 2.5 meters in length.
Decuriasuchus was first named by Marco Aurélio G. França, Jorge Ferigolo, and Max C. Langer in 2011.
Based on growth rate comparisons, an adult Decuriasuchus may have reached a size of approximately 6 meters (20 feet).
Decuriasuchus quartacolonia is classified as the basalmost member of the clade Loricata.
